changelog:
- Preferences and user data now persist across skill updates.
- Refined calorie tracking guidance: prioritizes photos, supports text logs, and limits to one clarifying question.
- Adjusts approach based on user goals (weight loss, maintenance, muscle gain) and discourages obsession with precision.
- Added stricter safety protocols: enhanced screening for contraindications and enforced calorie minimums.
- Simplified memory storage in `~/calories/memory.md`; auto-creates on first use.
- Removed and consolidated several guides and specialized files; core guidance now points to key documents (`goals.md`, `safety.md`, `estimation.md`).
summary: Track calories and macros conversationally. Auto-adapts to your goals and style.
